annotationProtocol.speech: Frame entirely inside a >=0.5 probability word after 60 ms erosion AND both WebRTC modes positive.
annotationProtocol.nonspeech: Both WebRTC modes negative AND no word within 100 ms; not proof of absence of breaths/noise.
annotationProtocol.uncertain: All other frames; entire clip uncertain if transcript WER >0.25.
annotationProtocol.sourceNoise: Unknown/unreviewed; no inferred fan, typing, music, or clean-room labels.
